purpose: Bounded finite discrete inverse amplification and Q4 width-refinement evidence, not universal stability/locking proof
fixture_reuse: Only build_specimen/make_loads/reference_fields/physical_resultant functions. Complete new derived registrations are logged; old manifest authority is not invoked or modified.

physical_references.loads: native side moment_x +M at y0/-M at y1 per x-length, solid side traction_y -Eaz at y0/+Eaz at y1; exact nonzero left six-DOF values; no right-tip load
physical_references.Q4_caveat: Exact continuum reference is NOT an exact Q4 normal trace;12matching cases are a finite refinement study

scaled_operator.P: selection only, one exact+1 per reduced column, disjoint row supports; noMPC/crosspoints
scaled_operator.G: stored rounded exact rational Uiface times positive l1 row norm of stored C D^-1
scaled_operator.formation_definition: Ideal scaling in exact arithmetic of canonical stored physical Kr/B and stored S/T/G/Lambda; normal finite reciprocal plus2multiplications per storedentry. gamma4 conservative.
scaled_operator.formation_relative_bound: gamma4/(1-gamma4) times abs(storedH); include its product withabsR in RIGHTdefect bound
scaled_operator.scope: FE assembly input values and recorded scales define the discrete problem. Certificate does not enclose continuum/model/discretization error.

certificate.inverse: LU computed actions are fully checked; no assumed LU backward error and no norm estimator upper bound
certificate.roundoff: IEEE binary64 round-nearest/ties-even with gradual underflow, gamma_n=n*u/(1-n*u). Outward nextafter for each bound add/mul/div and row accumulation, exact-rational scalar constants.
certificate.underflow: (2n+1)*minimum_subnormal/(1-n*u) additive bound per dot; scaling formation refuses every nonnormal/zero-underflow/nonfinite intermediate
certificate.abs_product_bound: fl(absH@absR) corrected upward by(gamma_n,underflow) before either arithmetic or formation use
certificate.eta: rowmax outward sum(|computed I-HR|+dot/subtract roundoff+formation correction)
certificate.physical_output: exact-rational row norm of DP*T divided by actual individual translation.000125/rotation.0005 checks; <=4. Physical output upper=4*primal inverse upper
certificate.not_claimed: Dual bound is modaltraction/couple only, NOT a recovered-interior-stress uncertainty certificate. No combined energy certificate.

finite_positive_energy.route: full QR of normalized B.T, raw m constraints, no ranktruncation; numerical null-defect upper<=1e-10, projected symmetry<=1e-10 and unregularizedCholesky
finite_positive_energy.claim: finite positive-energy numerical assessment only; not an exact coercivity certificate. Primary defended invertibility criterion is verified actual KKT inverse amplification.
finite_positive_energy.resource: sequential fullQ and projected matrix, largestnamedarrays orderN^2; estimate namedarray peak below128MB, excludes factor/libraryworkspace/RSS. Report actualarraybytes+phasewall; outer180s deadline is not waived

physical_acceptance.coarse: all observed errors/flags retained as diagnostics, never relabelled pass
physical_acceptance.interpretation: Stricter finite measured criteria, not rigorous combined energy/stress uncertainty bounds. No rate/plateau or locking assumption.
physical_acceptance.sampling: all solid quadrature samples .25<=x<=.75, all9tensorcomponents; fixedscale E*a*t/2; no smoothing/exclusions; physicalsupportreactions only plusallloads and prescribedsupportwork
physical_acceptance.mixed_global_displacement: MAX(native whole-nodal translation error, whole-solid coefficient displacement error at actual P2 coordinates/components), each divided by .000125. Solid normal shifts count even if native DOFs and stress are accurate.

cases.shift_registration: interior solid corners moved by +1/(4*Nv)=.05m, quarter of finer solid cell; endpoints0/1 fixed
interior solid corners moved by +1/(4*Nv)=.05m, quarter of finer solid cell; endpoints0/1 fixed

terminal_behavior: Partialidentity/case/phase/inverse-column records flush. No numerical retries. Exceptions/deadline stop remaining cases; retain all failed gates. Scientific failures stayNO_GO.
promotion: All resultsresearch-only; boundedcases cannot establish universalstability or removehistorical/productionNO_GO.

independent_reference_policy.route: Public ANYsolid P2 K+affine traction; direct SciPy essential-boundary sparse LU; no native, ShellEdgeTrace, coupling or host solve imports/calls. Executed before all native/coupling cases.
independent_reference_policy.BVP: Fullbodyx[-1,2],y[0,1],z±t/2; exact u on ALL x=-1 face coefficients; y0 traction_y=-E*a*z,y1=+E*a*z; allotherfacesnaturalzero, bodyzero.
independent_reference_policy.reference: Exact representable quadratic width-bending field and sigma_yy=E*a*z; theoretical analytical reference uncertainty0. Numerical solves are independent corroboration only.
independent_reference_policy.comparison: ALL primary/all boundary coefficients and ALL quadrature tensor stresses against analytic; actual fine-minus-coarse displacement at coarse coefficient coordinates via upstream public trace plus global energy difference. Full stress fields on both levels compare independently to analytic, no difference-of-maxima claim.
independent_reference_policy.prerequisite: Both meshes at every thickness must pass; if any reference accuracy check fails, retain all6reference outcomes and stop before the18metric/12coupled phase. No retry or fitted reference.

runtime.verification: eager load SciPy linalg/sparse.linalg, inspect actual pools and refuse non1; log pools plus effective supervisor environment
